alternatives_rejected.why: The cpu deviation (z=48.04) is about 4.6x smaller than mem (z=223.66) in E1, which fits GC or paging pressure caused by memory exhaustion rather than a primary CPU fault.
The socket deviation (z=14.71, E1) is minor compared with mem and is best explained as connections piling up behind slow, memory-starved request handling.
It sits in the worst trace paths (E3), but those paths end at productcatalogservice, and E1 shows no significant deviation for currencyservice in the all-services ranking.
It is only the entry point of the slow paths (E3) and has no metric deviation in E1.

proposed_fix.description: Do a rolling restart of the productcatalogservice pods to reclaim leaked memory, and raise the memory limit or add a replica as a stopgap. Before restarting, capture a heap profile from one pod so the leak can be found and fixed in code. Afterwards, watch the mem and cpu metrics to confirm they return to baseline.
